name: himandme-ghost-theme
description: Custom Ghost theme for Him & Me (himandme.my): clinical-inspired main site and editorial blog.

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run guard && npm run gscan

whatsapp_number.description: Digits only, international format, e.g. 60123456789. Used by all WhatsApp buttons.

whatsapp_default_message.default: Salam, saya ingin bertanya tentang perkhidmatan Him & Me.
whatsapp_default_message.description: Prefilled message for general WhatsApp buttons (header, sticky bar).

phone_display.description: Phone number exactly as it should be shown.

address_short.description: Short address for the top bar. Full address: content block 'maklumat-hubungan'.

google_maps_url.description: Google Maps link. Leave empty to hide the link.

opening_hours_short.description: One-line opening hours for the top bar and contact panel.

consultation_duration.description: Consultation length on the Disfungsi Ereksi page, e.g. 30 minit.

consultation_fee.description: Consultation fee on the Disfungsi Ereksi page.

shockwave_session_duration.description: Shockwave therapy: length of one session.

kegel_ems_session_duration.description: Kegel EMS: length of one session.

show_prices.description: Show the fee and price tiles on the Disfungsi Ereksi page.

doctor_author_slug.description: Slug of the doctor's staff profile, used for the homepage doctor card.

doctor_credentials.description: Verified credentials shown under 'Ditulis dan disemak oleh' on articles.
